title: Every Premier League Golden Boot winner, by age
checked: Winners and goals from the local history file and Wikipedia (42 winners in 34 seasons, shared boots counted once each). Age = age at the end of the winning season from dates of birth; Owen (14 Dec 1979) 18 in 1997-98, 19 in 1998-99, both shared on 18 goals (LFC History, Wikipedia); only teenager. Counts by age: 18-21 = 2, 22-24 = 8, 25-27 = 18, 28-30 = 11, 31-33 = 3 (Drogba 32, Salah 32, Vardy 33). Vardy (11 Jan 1987) at Stocksbridge Park Steels to 2010, Halifax 2010-11, Fleetwood 2011-12, Leicester 2012 for about GBP 1m, a non-league record; first Premier League season 2014-15 aged 27; 2019-20 Golden Boot with 23 (Ings and Aubameyang 22), season finished 26 July 2020, oldest winner at 33 (Guinness, Squawka, Wikipedia). Vardy volley v Liverpool 2 Feb 2016 from Mahrez's long ball (LCFC, FourFourTwo). Salah's fourth in 2024-25 equals Henry (Liverpool FC, Premier League). Haaland's third, 27 goals, 2025-26, aged 25 (Premier League, Man City).

lines.text: The Premier League's top scorer has been eighteen years old. And thirty-three. This is every Golden Boot, by age.
lines.say: The Premier League's top scorer has been eighteen years old. And thirty-three. This is every Golden Boot, by age.

lines.text: Nineteen ninety-eight. Michael Owen, eighteen, shares the Golden Boot in his first full season.
lines.say: Nineteen ninety-eight. Michael Owen, eighteen, shares the Golden Boot in his first full season.

lines.text: A year later he shared it again, at nineteen. He's still the only teenager to win it.
lines.say: A year later he shared it again, at nineteen. He's still the only teenager to win it.

lines.text: Most winners are in their mid-twenties. Shearer, Henry, Kane, Haaland.
lines.say: Most winners are in their mid-twenties. Shearer, Onree, Kane, Hohland.

lines.text: Past thirty-one, there are just three. And the oldest has the best story.
lines.say: Past thirty-one, there are just three. And the oldest has the best story.

lines.text: Jamie Vardy. At twenty-two he was playing non-league football for Stocksbridge Park Steels.
lines.say: Jamie Vardy. At twenty-two he was playing non-league football for Stocksbridge Park Steels.

lines.text: In twenty sixteen, Leicester won the league. And Vardy scored goals like this one against Liverpool.
lines.say: In twenty sixteen, Lester won the league. And Vardy scored goals like this one against Liverpool.

lines.text: Then twenty twenty. A season stopped by the pandemic, and finished in July.
lines.say: Then twenty twenty. A season stopped by the pandemic, and finished in July.

lines.text: Vardy was thirty-three. The oldest Golden Boot winner in Premier League history.
lines.say: Vardy was thirty-three. The oldest Golden Boot winner in Premier League history.

lines.text: Salah came close. His fourth Golden Boot came at thirty-two, and equalled Thierry Henry's record.
lines.say: Sahlah came close. His fourth Golden Boot came at thirty-two, and equalled Teeairee Onree's record.

lines.text: And last season, Haaland won his third, at twenty-five. Twenty-seven goals.
lines.say: And last season, Hohland won his third, at twenty-five. Twenty-seven goals.

lines.text: So the Golden Boot has gone to an eighteen-year-old and a thirty-three-year-old. Fifteen years apart.
lines.say: So the Golden Boot has gone to an eighteen-year-old and a thirty-three-year-old. Fifteen years apart.

lines.text: And Vardy got there the long way round.
lines.say: And Vardy got there the long way round.
